phase: Phase 21: Multi-Group Inter-Convoy Gateway & Cross-Mesh Federation

stories.title: Pure KMP Multi-Group Gateway Engine & Cross-Mesh Federation Protocol
stories.description: Implement pure KMP FederationModels.kt, InterGroupGateway.kt, and CrossMeshRelayEngine.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/federation/. Defines inter-group gateway contracts (GroupFederationInvite, FederationBridgeState, CrossGroupPolicy, CrossMeshAudioPacket). Implements gateway leader arbitration, policy-driven audio and hazard bridging between distinct cryptographic groups (Squad A vs Squad B) with key translation or re-encryption, preventing unauthorized spillover while enabling seamless intercom between road captains. Pure KMP with 0 Java/C dependencies (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP implementation with zero Java, C, or platform-specific dependencies in commonMain (Rules 2 & 3)
Defines and handles GroupFederationInvite, FederationBridgeState, and CrossGroupPolicy models
Implements gateway leader election and policy-driven packet translation between distinct cryptographic group keys
Provides CrossMeshRelayEngine re-encrypting voice frames with destination group key
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Selective Inter-Group Audio Demuxing, Sub-Group Isolation & Anti-Feedback Loop Guard
stories.description: Implement FederationLoopDetector.kt and CrossMeshForwardingArbiter.kt in mesh/federation/. Integrates cross-mesh audio bridging into MeshTransport and audio pipeline. Prevents acoustic and relay feedback loops across redundant gateway bridges via monotonic federationPathTrace and cross-group deduplication. Enforces sub-group isolation (e.g. private squad chatter remains internal; only designated Captain PTT or Emergency SOS bridges across convoys).
acceptanceCriteria: Suppresses circular relay feedback loops across multiple concurrent gateways using path trace verification
Enforces strict sub-group isolation rules: CAPTAIN_ONLY, EMERGENCY_SOS_ONLY, and ALL_MEMBER_BRIDGED
Drops unauthorized or unverified cross-group packets without decrypting payload
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Subsystem Hardware Bridge Wiring & Multiplatform Federation HUD Presentation
stories.description: Wire InterGroupGateway into IntercomHardwareBridge, AndroidPlatformBridge, and IntercomBridge (iosMain) with typed CancellationHandle observers. Expose reactive FederationSnapshot (connected sibling groups, bridge policy, gateway link RSSI, relayed packet counts) and gateway control hooks. Present Multi-Group Federation badge and diagnostics sheet in Compose Multiplatform (HomeScreen.kt) and 100% Native iOS SwiftUI (ContentView.swift / IntercomViewModel.swift respecting Rule 1).
acceptanceCriteria: Hardware bridges expose federation snapshot flow and federation bridge control hooks
Exposes reactive CancellationHandle observers for federation state on iOS (Rule 1)
Compose Multiplatform displays cross-group federation status strip and diagnostics dialog
100% Native iOS SwiftUI displays tactical federation pill and modal sheet (Rule 1)
Full compilation and automated verification pass across all targets

stories.title: Dual-Convoy 32-Node Cross-Mesh Simulation Harness & Archify Showcase Update
stories.description: Implement MultiGroupFederationSimulationHarness.kt simulating a dual-squad convoy (Squad Alpha 16 nodes, Squad Bravo 16 nodes) with 2 dual-role gateway nodes. Validates sub-group isolation, <25ms gateway re-encryption latency, zero broadcast loops across redundant gateways, and emergency all-call preemption across both meshes. Update Archify interactive architecture specifications to showcase quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 32 nodes across 2 distinct cryptographic groups with dual gateway nodes
Demonstrates sub-group audio isolation under normal traffic and universal relay on Emergency SOS
Verifies zero circular feedback loops when both gateways operate simultaneously
Archify architecture specification and HTML showcase updated with 9/9 verification pass
Full multiplatform test suite pass across all targets
